snippet.title: Gun Shop: Tidy Up – Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Gun Shop: Tidy Up launched worldwide on Windows PC on September 1, 2026. Restore order to a chaotic gun shop by collecting and arranging more than 2,700 items, upgrading your abilities, and turning every shelf into a neatly organized display.

Release date: September 1, 2026
Platform listed on UGDB: Windows PC
Region: Worldwide
Developer: kotcool
Publisher: kotcool

Discover Gun Shop: Tidy Up on Ultimate Game Database:
https://ugdb.gg/games/gun-shop-tidy-up
